body:
## Summary
- make full album stages use their own YouTube cover when set, otherwise inherit the source album cover
- show the selected album cover preview from both the pipeline choose-file button and the visible YouTube cover field tooltip
- refresh the floating cover preview tooltip when the selected cover image finishes loading during hover/focus
- make derived full-album stages display inherited source album file names instead of the empty file state
- add a case study under `docs/case-studies/issue-193` with downloaded issue/PR data, screenshots, CI/log artifacts, timeline, root cause, and alternatives
- extend the full-album Cypress flow to assert inherited thumbnail upload, rendered cover preview image state, and inherited file-name display

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#193

## Root Cause
Full-album stages correctly resolved source album files and covers for validation/execution, but the visible UI was incomplete in three places: the derived file button rendered from the derived stage's own empty `fileNames`, the selected YouTube cover preview was originally not attached to the visible `YouTube cover` field itself, and the cover-preview path did not refresh the floating image tooltip after `FileReader` finished while the user was already hovering/focusing the trigger. That left users seeing a text/fallback tooltip instead of the selected cover image.

## Tests
- `npm test -- --runInBand` passed: 9 suites, 342 tests
- `npm run build` passed with existing Rollup warnings
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` ran locally with 25 passing and 2 unrelated existing failures; the updated full-album cover/file inheritance test passed, including the assertion that `#pipelinePreviewTooltip` receives a `data:image/png` preview. Remaining failures are the pre-existing navigator active-state assertion at `cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:257` and relative publish-date assertion at `cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js:397`. Logs are saved in `docs/case-studies/issue-193/logs/`.

## Case Study
See `docs/case-studies/issue-193/README.md` for the downloaded data, timeline, root cause analysis, and possible solutions.
